behaviors.description: Exercise explicit developer feature flags in the implicitly privileged build sandbox.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent build runtime and separately compiled ptrace probe; host syscall control succeeds.
behaviors.expected: Ordinary, allow-devel and disallow-devel builds all retain build's implicit developer syscall access. No distinct permission-enforcement effect is claimed.

mappings.rationale: Actual ptrace calls establish the tested ordinary build result under explicit flags; this does not claim that these flags restrict a build sandbox.

equivalent_options.rationale: Explicit devel allowance preserves implicit build privileges.
The tested devel revocation does not remove build's implicit developer privileges; equivalence only.
